title: Shut the Door
setup: White's bishop has grabbed a pawn on a7, deep in your camp, with only b8 and b6 to come home through.
hint: Your rook on c8 already watches one of the two doors. Close the other with something the bishop cannot safely take.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b6}} takes the bishop's last square, and the pawn is defended by c7, so Bxb6 cxb6 wins a piece for a pawn. The rook covers b8, White's own a2-pawn blocks the a-file, and c7 stops any rook from reaching a7 along the rank. Ra8 next.
